_key.description: Variant key and coding variant key joined by an underscore. Hashed with SHA-256 when the composite would exceed the 254-character key limit.

_from.description: Document handle of the genomic variant.

_to.description: Document handle of the coding variant this genomic variant produces.

name.description: Directional human readable label for the relationship, _from to _to.

inverse_name.description: Reversed directional human readable label for the relationship, _to to _from.

chr.description: Chromosome the genomic variant lies on, prefixed with 'chr'. Scaffolds and patch regions use UCSC-style names.

ref.description: Reference allele of the genomic variant.

alt.description: Alternate allele of the genomic variant.

label.description: Non-method specific human readable label for the node or edge

source.description: The database, dataset or organization that is a source for these data.
